content_html:
What is DayOtter?

DayOtter connects all your calendars - Google, Microsoft 365, Apple (CalDAV), and any ICS feed - and treats them as one. Your booking availability, your focus time, and every conflict check respect every calendar you own, so a personal appointment automatically blocks a work slot and you never get double-booked across accounts. On top of that: booking pages, team round-robin, reminders, and payments - with an AI assistant, Otter, built into the core rather than bolted on.

Most schedulers hand out a link and stop there. Otter actually does the work. You describe what you want in plain language - in the app, by voice, or over WhatsApp / SMS - and Otter drafts the action; you approve it. It protects your focus time, nudges your next meeting when you're running late, surfaces proactive suggestions, and learns your patterns over time. Crucially, it is confirm-first: it never changes your calendar without your OK.

Think Calendly + Motion + a real assistant - except open-source and self-hostable in one command, with every AI feature included.

Why DayOtter

  • One link, every calendar. Share a single booking page that's conflict-aware across all your Google / Microsoft / Apple accounts at once - not one link per calendar.
  • Genuinely open, including the AI. AGPLv3; self-host the whole product - Otter included - for free, forever. (Calendly is closed; Cal.com went closed-source in 2026.)
  • The AI runs where you want it. Local model via Ollama/vLLM for zero phone-home, or bring your own key - and it's confirm-first, so it never reshuffles your calendar behind your back.

The AI is optional and never a black box. DayOtter runs as a complete scheduler with no AI configured at all. Turn Otter on by pointing it at a model you choose: Anthropic or OpenAI, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local model via Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM - so nothing has to leave your server. See Self-hosting the AI.

Who it's for

  • Individuals - a booking page and an assistant that clears the scheduling back-and-forth for you.
  • Teams - weighted round-robin, collective availability, routing forms, and shared analytics.
  • Organisations & self-hosters - run the entire product on your own infrastructure under AGPLv3, keep your calendar data on your servers, and roll the mobile app out to your whole team pointed at your own instance (see Mobile app).

Why we're building it

Scheduling is where a lot of knowledge work quietly leaks time, and the good tools are closing up. Calendly is closed and cloud-only. Cal.com moved its core to a closed repo in April 2026 - citing AI - leaving only a stripped-down MIT fork with the commercial features removed. Motion and Reclaim were never open at all.

We think the assistant that reads your calendar and acts on your time is exactly the thing that should be open, inspectable, and self-hostable - not a black box you rent. So DayOtter stays genuinely open: AGPLv3, self-host the whole product - including all of Otter's AI - for free, forever. Not a demo, not a stripped fork.

Features

Scheduling · unlimited event types & booking pages · Google / Microsoft 365 / Apple (CalDAV) / ICS calendar sync · availability engine with buffers, notice, timezones · recurring meetings · group polls · accept payments (Stripe) · prepaid session packages

Teams · weighted round-robin & collective booking · routing forms · shared availability · per-seat billing

Otter (AI) · natural-language command bar · voice input (mobile) · inbound WhatsApp/SMS · AI voice receptionist (24/7 phone line) · focus auto-scheduling · running-late overflow alerts · proactive suggestions · long-term memory · post-meeting recap. See docs/AI.md.

Insight · booking analytics + "where your time goes" time-allocation · CSV export

Platform · multi-channel reminders (email, Slack, WhatsApp, SMS, push) · automations & workflows · API keys & webhooks · mobile app (Expo, iOS + Android)

Mobile app

The Android app is live on Google Play: play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dayotter.app. The iOS build (same Expo/React Native codebase in apps/mobile) is on the way.

It covers the day-to-day host workflow - dashboard, bookings, availability, event types, calendars, insights, reminders/channels, automations, workflows, and preferences - with voice input for Otter.

Bring your own server - built for organisations. The app isn't hard-wired to our cloud. It ships with a Server setting where anyone can point the same app at their own self-hosted DayOtter instance. So an organisation can:

  1. Self-host DayOtter once (Docker Compose - see below).
  2. Have their team install the same app from the store (or an internal/EAS build).
  3. Each person switches the server to the org's instance and signs in - their data never leaves the org's infrastructure.

No forking, no per-org app build required. One app, any DayOtter server.

Note: the app is pre-1.0 and evolving quickly. Android push works out of the box for the Play Store build. Self-hosters point it at their own Firebase project by dropping apps/mobile/google-services.json (or setting GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON); app.config.js wires it up automatically.

Open-core

DayOtter is open-core, the way Cal.com used to be:

  • Everything outside ee/ is AGPLv3 - the whole product, including all of Otter's AI. Self-host it and pay nothing.
  • ee/ is a small, separately-licensed commercial layer for cloud-only infrastructure - Managed AI (no key to configure), SSO, white-label, hosted messaging. It's inert unless DAYOTTER_CLOUD=1. See apps/web/lib/ee/LICENSE.md and docs/ENTERPRISE.md.

You do not need ee/ to run the full product.

How we intend to make money — and our promise. The plan is a hosted DayOtter Cloud (convenience: managed AI with no key to configure, hosted messaging, SSO, white-label) for people who don't want to run servers. That's it. The self-hostable product — booking, teams, routing, workflows, insights, payments, and all of Otter's AI logic — stays AGPLv3 and free, forever. We will not move the core to a closed or "source-available" repo. If that ever changes, AGPLv3 guarantees the last open version can be forked and carried on by anyone — which is the whole point.

Project status: early and moving fast. DayOtter is a young project (first public code mid-2026). It's broad and usable, but it is not yet battle-tested at scale, and enterprise pieces (SSO/SAML, SCIM, audit logs, SOC 2 / HIPAA) are on the roadmap, not shipped. Kick the tires, self-host it, and help shape it - issues and PRs welcome.

Monorepo layout

apps/
  web       Next.js 15 - dashboard, public booking pages, REST API, Otter
  worker    Node + BullMQ - reminders, calendar sync, briefings, scribe
  mobile    Expo (React Native) - iOS + Android
packages/
  core          availability engine, round-robin, crypto (pure, unit-tested)
  db            Drizzle schema + Postgres client
  jobs          BullMQ queue contracts (shared producer/consumer)
  calendar      Google / Microsoft / Apple adapters behind one interface
  integrations  provider OAuth + sync
  notifications multi-channel delivery (Slack, Twilio, Expo/web push)
  emails        transactional email (Resend / SMTP)
  auth          Better Auth config (email, Google, phone/OTP)

Full breakdown: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

Quick start (development)

Prerequisites: Node 20+, pnpm 10+, and Docker (for Postgres + Redis). Everything else installs with pnpm install.

git clone https://github.com/Dayotter/dayotter && cd dayotter

# 1. Datastores - starts Postgres + Redis in the background
docker compose up -d

# 2. Config - copy the example and fill in what you need. It runs with sane
#    defaults; add OAuth creds + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable calendar sync + Otter.
cp .env.example .env

# 3. Install deps and create the database schema
pnpm install
pnpm db:push

# 4. Run the web app (:3000) + the background worker together
pnpm dev

Open http://localhost:3000, create an account, and you have a working booking page. Integrations (Google/Microsoft calendar, Stripe, Twilio, AI) are all optional and off until you add their keys - see docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.

Run the mobile app against your local server with pnpm --filter @dayotter/mobile start (point its Server setting at your machine).

Common commands: pnpm dev · pnpm typecheck · pnpm test · pnpm check (Biome format + lint). See AGENTS.md for conventions.

Stack: TypeScript · Next.js 15 · Expo (mobile) · Postgres + Drizzle · Redis + BullMQ · Luxon · Anthropic (Otter) · Better Auth · Stripe · Twilio.

Self-hosting (production)

Run the whole product - web, worker, Postgres, Redis - on your own infrastructure under AGPLv3. AI is optional: DayOtter is a full scheduler with no model configured; add a key or a local model to turn Otter on. Every path below runs database migrations for you.

1. One-click - the host provisions everything:

   

Fly.io, Railway, AWS, and per-platform notes are in the deploy guide →.

2. Your own server, one command - installs Docker, generates secrets, starts everything (Postgres, Redis, web, worker, and a Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS):

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dayotter/dayotter/main/deploy/install.sh \
  | sudo DAYOTTER_DOMAIN=cal.example.com bash

Prefer to drive Docker Compose yourself? See deploy/README.md. Upgrade a running instance safely (back up → migrate → health-check → roll back on failure) with deploy/upgrade.sh.

Then: connect integrations (Google, Microsoft, Apple, Stripe, Twilio, …) - where to get each client ID / key and which redirect URI & webhook to register: docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.

Community

  • 💬 Discord - real-time chat with the community and the team. Come say hi.
  • 🗣️ Discussions - ask a question (Q&A), propose an idea, or show what you built. Durable, searchable answers live here.
  • 🐛 Issues - report a bug or request a feature.
  • 🔒 Security policy - report a vulnerability privately (don't open a public issue).
  • 🤝 Code of conduct · How to get help

Contributing

We'd love your help - see CONTRIBUTING.md for setup, conventions, and the PR flow, docs/TASKS.md for ready-to-start work, and docs/ROADMAP.md for where we're headed. Good first issues are labelled on the tracker. By contributing, you agree your changes are licensed under AGPLv3 (or the EE license for ee/).

License

  • Core: GNU AGPLv3 - free to use, self-host, modify, and share.
  • ee/: DayOtter Enterprise Edition License - commercial, cloud-only.

content_html_zh:
什么是DayOtter？

DayOtter 连接您的所有日历 - Google、Microsoft 365、Apple (CalDAV) 和任何 ICS feed - 并将它们视为一个整体。 您的预订可用性、您的专注时间和每次冲突检查都会尊重您拥有的每个日历，因此个人约会会自动阻止工作空档，并且您永远不会跨帐户重复预订。 最重要的是：预订页面、团队循环、提醒和付款——人工智能助手 Otter 内置于核心而不是附加的。

大多数调度员会分发一个链接并就此停止。 水獭实际上做了这项工作。 您可以用简单的语言（在应用程序中、通过语音或通过 WhatsApp / SMS）描述您想要的内容，然后 Otter 起草行动；你批准了。 它可以保护您的专注时间，在您迟到时提醒您召开下一次会议，提出主动建议，并随着时间的推移了解您的模式。 至关重要的是，它是“确认优先”：未经您的同意，它绝不会更改您的日历。

Think Calendly + Motion + 真正的助手 - 除了开源和可在一个命令中自行托管之外，还包含所有人工智能功能。

为什么选择DayOtter

  • 一个链接，每个日历。 一次性共享一个预订页面，该页面可在您的所有 Google/Microsoft/Apple 帐户之间进行冲突感知 - 而不是每个日历一个链接。
  • 真正开放，包括AI。 AGPLv3；永久免费自行托管整个产品（包括 Otter）。 （Calendly 已关闭；Cal.com 于 2026 年关闭源代码。）
  • 人工智能可以在您想要的地方运行。 通过 Ollama/vLLM 的本地模型可实现零电话回家，或自带钥匙 - 而且它是先确认的，因此它永远不会在您背后重新调整您的日历。
人工智能是可选的，绝不是黑匣子。 DayOtter 作为一个完整的调度程序运行，根本没有配置 AI。 通过将 Otter 指向您选择的模型来打开 Otter：Anthropic 或 OpenAI、任何 OpenAI 兼容端点，或通过 Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM 的本地模型 - 所以没有任何东西可以离开您的服务器。 请参阅自托管 AI。

这是给谁的

  • 个人 - 一个预订页面和一个助手，可以为您来回清理日程安排。
  • 团队 - 加权循环赛、集体可用性、路由表和共享分析。
  • 组织和自托管者 - 在 AGPLv3 下您自己的基础设施上运行整个产品，将您的日历数据保存在您的服务器上，并将移动应用程序推广到指向您自己的实例的整个团队（请参阅移动应用程序）。

我们为什么要建造它

日程安排是很多知识工作悄悄流失时间的地方，好的工具都关门了。 Calendly 是封闭的且仅限云。 Cal.com 于 2026 年 4 月将其核心转移到一个封闭的存储库 - 引用人工智能 - 只留下一个精简的 MIT 分支，并删除了商业功能。 动议和回收从来没有开放过。

我们认为，读取你的日历并根据你的时间采取行动的助手应该是开放的、可检查的和可自我托管的——而不是你租用的黑匣子。 因此，DayOtter 保持真正的开放：AGPLv3，自托管整个产品 - 包括 Otter 的所有人工智能 - 永远免费。 不是演示，也不是剥离的叉子。

特征

日程安排 · 无限的活动类型和预订页面 · Google / Microsoft 365 / Apple (CalDAV) / ICS 日历同步 · 具有缓冲区、通知、时区的可用性引擎 · 定期会议 · 小组投票 · 接受付款 (Stripe) · 预付费会议套餐

团队 · 加权循环和集体预订 · 路由表 · 共享可用性 · 按席位计费

Otter (AI) · 自然语言命令栏 · 语音输入（移动） · 呼入 WhatsApp/SMS · 人工智能语音接待员（24/7 电话线） · 焦点自动安排 · 迟到溢出警报 ​​· 主动建议 · 长期记忆 · 会后回顾。 请参阅文档/AI.md。

洞察力·预订分析+“你的时间都花在哪里”时间分配·CSV导出

平台 · 多渠道提醒（电子邮件、Slack、WhatsApp、短信、推送） · 自动化和工作流程 · API 密钥和 webhooks · 移动应用程序（Expo、iOS + Android）

移动应用程序

Android 应用程序已在 Google Play 上上线：play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dayotter.app。 iOS 构建（应用程序/移动设备中的相同 Expo/React Native 代码库）正在进行中。

它涵盖了日常主持人工作流程 - 仪表板、预订、可用性、事件类型、日历、见解、提醒/频道、自动化、工作流程和首选项 - 以及 Otter 的语音输入。

自带服务器 - 专为组织构建。 该应用程序没有硬连接到我们的云。 它附带一个服务器设置，任何人都可以将同一个应用程序指向自己的自托管 DayOtter 实例。 因此，组织可以：

  1. 自托管 DayOtter 一次（Docker Compose - 见下文）。
  2. 让他们的团队从商店安装相同的应用程序（或内部/EAS 版本）。
  3. 每个人将服务器切换到组织的实例并登录 - 他们的数据永远不会离开组织的基础设施。

无需分叉，无需构建每个组织的应用程序。 一个应用程序，任何 DayOtter 服务器。

注意：该应用程序是 1.0 之前的版本，并且正在快速发展。 Android 推送对于 Play Store 构建来说是开箱即用的。 自托管者通过删除 apps/mobile/google-services.json （或设置 GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON）将其指向自己的 Firebase 项目； app.config.js 自动连接它。

开放核心

DayOtter 是开放核心的，就像 Cal.com 过去那样：

  • ee/ 之外的所有内容都是 AGPLv3 - 整个产品，包括 Otter 的所有 AI。 自行托管，无需支付任何费用。
  • ee/ 是一个小型、单独许可的商业层，适用于纯云基础设施 - 托管 AI（无需配置密钥）、SSO、白标签、托管消息传递。 除非 DAYOTTER_CLOUD=1，否则它是惰性的。 请参阅 apps/web/lib/ee/LICENSE.md 和 docs/ENTERPRISE.md。

您不需要 ee/ 来运行完整的产品。

我们打算如何赚钱——以及我们的承诺。 该计划是一个托管的 DayOtter Cloud（方便：无需配置密钥的托管 AI、托管消息传递、SSO、白标签），适合那些不想运行服务器的人。 就是这样。 自托管产品——预订、团队、路由、工作流程、洞察、支付以及 Otter 的所有人工智能逻辑——将永远保持 AGPLv3 且免费。 我们不会将核心移至封闭或“源可用”的存储库。 如果这种情况发生变化，AGPLv3 保证最后一个开放版本可以被任何人分叉和继承——这就是重点。

项目状态：早期且进展迅速。 DayOtter 是一个年轻的项目（第一个公共代码于 2026 年中期）。 它广泛且可用，但尚未经过大规模的实战测试，企业部分（SSO/SAML、SCIM、审核日志、SOC 2 / HIPAA）已在路线图上，尚未交付。 尝试一下、自行托管并帮助塑造它 - 欢迎提出问题和 PR。

Monorepo 布局

apps/
  web       Next.js 15 - dashboard, public booking pages, REST API, Otter
  worker    Node + BullMQ - reminders, calendar sync, briefings, scribe
  mobile    Expo (React Native) - iOS + Android
packages/
  core          availability engine, round-robin, crypto (pure, unit-tested)
  db            Drizzle schema + Postgres client
  jobs          BullMQ queue contracts (shared producer/consumer)
  calendar      Google / Microsoft / Apple adapters behind one interface
  integrations  provider OAuth + sync
  notifications multi-channel delivery (Slack, Twilio, Expo/web push)
  emails        transactional email (Resend / SMTP)
  auth          Better Auth config (email, Google, phone/OTP)

完整细分：docs/ARCHITECTURE.md。

快速启动（开发）

先决条件：Node 20+、pnpm 10+ 和 Docker（适用于 Postgres + Redis）。 其他一切都通过 pnpm install 安装。

git clone https://github.com/Dayotter/dayotter && cd dayotter

# 1. Datastores - starts Postgres + Redis in the background
docker compose up -d

# 2. Config - copy the example and fill in what you need. It runs with sane
#    defaults; add OAuth creds + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable calendar sync + Otter.
cp .env.example .env

# 3. Install deps and create the database schema
pnpm install
pnpm db:push

# 4. Run the web app (:3000) + the background worker together
pnpm dev

打开 http://localhost:3000，创建一个帐户，您就有了一个有效的预订页面。 集成（Google/Microsoft 日历、Stripe、Twilio、AI）都是可选的，并且在您添加它们的密钥之前关闭 - 请参阅 docs/INTEGRATIONS.md。

使用 pnpm --filter @dayotter/mobile start 针对本地服务器运行移动应用程序（将其服务器设置指向您的计算机）。

常用命令：pnpm dev · pnpm typecheck · pnpm test · pnpm check（Biome 格式 + lint）。 请参阅 AGENTS.md 了解约定。

堆栈：TypeScript · Next.js 15 · Expo（移动） · Postgres + Drizzle · Redis + BullMQ · Luxon · Anthropic (Otter) · Better Auth · Stripe · Twilio。

在您自己的 AGPLv3 基础设施上运行整个产品 - web、worker、Postgres、Redis。 AI是可选的：DayOtter是一个完整的调度器，没有配置模型；添加钥匙或本地模型来打开 Otter。 下面的每条路径都会为您运行数据库迁移。

1. 一键式 - 主机配置一切：

   

Fly.io、Railway、AWS 和每个平台的说明位于部署指南 → 中。

2. 您自己的服务器，一个命令 - 安装 Docker、生成机密、启动所有内容（Postgres、Redis、Web、worker 和带有自动 HTTPS 的 Caddy 反向代理）：

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dayotter/dayotter/main/deploy/install.sh \

更喜欢自己驱动 Docker Compose？ 请参阅部署/README.md。 使用deploy/upgrade.sh 安全地升级正在运行的实例（备份→迁移→运行状况检查→失败时回滚）。
